verdict.rationale: Modal documents an official CLI at modal.com/docs/reference/cli. It can run a command or interactive shell inside a Modal container and manage and connect to running containers, which covers the story's core requirement of an official CLI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, explicit documentation of sandbox-specific CLI commands, and evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run a command or interactive shell inside a Modal container.
Manage and connect to running containers.
